inheritedContract: all V2 and V3 schemas, APIs, reasons, fault oracles, ownership and no-cutover constraints remain normative except the three explicit amendments below

transactionalDecisionAuthority.predicate: the Scheduled state and lastObservedAt used by reconcile_slot are read from the same verified SQLite connection after BEGIN IMMEDIATE and after prior zero-entry import has converged
transactionalDecisionAuthority.controllerPolicy: Controller may validate manifest and time before the ledger call but must not supply a final decision derived from separately read mutable ledger state
transactionalDecisionAuthority.ledgerPolicy: ControlLedger.reconcile receives the validated manifest or an equivalent immutable schedule contract, reads lastObservedAt and Scheduled row in its transaction, calls reconcile_slot there, and persists and returns that exact decision
transactionalDecisionAuthority.concurrentOracle: an outer 06:40 invocation that observed ABSENT before a competing 06:39 Scheduled commit must return ENSURE_AUDIT_OBSERVING_SCHEDULED, scheduledState ACTIVE, create or attach Audit, and never synthesize MISSED_SCHEDULED
transactionalDecisionAuthority.clockRollbackPolicy: rollback comparison also uses transaction-local lastObservedAt; initial invocation WAL remains recoverable on typed rollback

repeatedRecovery.predicate: COMMITTED journal plus healthy ledger is RECOVERY_NOT_REQUIRED; COMMITTED journal plus corrupt ledger starts one new recovery from the current generation
repeatedRecovery.identity: second recoveryId differs, oldGeneration equals the current sealed generation, newGeneration is exactly old plus one, and quarantine path differs
repeatedRecovery.history: the prior COMMITTED journal is durably preserved under control/recovery-history/<priorRecoveryId>.json before the active recovery journal is replaced
repeatedRecovery.return: the second recovery returns recovered only after reopen verify succeeds; a crash resumes the new identity without an additional generation increment

recoveryWrapper.exactSignature: recover_ledger(*, runtime_root, manifest_path, observed_at, durability_ops=None, boundary_hook=None, busy_timeout_ms=1000) -> CONTROL_LEDGER_RECOVERY_V1
recoveryWrapper.forwarding: busy_timeout_ms is forwarded unchanged into Controller and then ControlLedger
recoveryWrapper.invalidPolicy: bool, non-int, zero or negative timeout remains rejected through the same constructor/ledger validation used by dispatch
